entries.prompt: British Army Challenger 3 main battle tank (Rheinmetall BAE Systems Land upgrade of Challenger 2), three-quarter front view from the left, on open ground in daylight, photographic reference. Challenger 2 hull and running gear (six road wheels, side skirts, dozer-free glacis) in British NATO green; the new angular welded Challenger 3 turret with a long L55A1 120 mm smoothbore gun without fume extractor, a thermal sleeve, two Trophy active protection radar panels and launchers on the turret sides, the commander's panoramic sight on the right roof, a remote weapon station, smoke grenade dischargers, bustle stowage. Whole vehicle in frame, no people, no text.
